newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers mixed, Los Angeles gains.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers mixed, Los Angeles gains.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mixed Tuesday from prices late last week, with Los Angeles gaining from a spurt of demand from Asian buyers wanting to buy barrels ahead of the Christmas holidays, traders said.
Los Angeles 380 CST was offered at $121.00 a tonne, up $2 from last Thursday, with 180 CST pegged between $126 and $128, brokers said.
"There was a lot of demand today, with at least 15,000 tonnes of inquiries and quite a few deals done," one Los Angeles trader said.
"Asian ships know if they want something done it's better to do it now because we're getting into the holidays," the trader added.
Prices trended $3 lower in Seattle, however, in a retracement from strong price gains last week, with 380 CST offered at $125, traders said.
On the East Coast, New York Harbor 380 CST remained about $120, with Norfolk 380 CST stable at 136.00, players said.
Houston 380 CST jumped $3 to $109, players said.
